items.title: Add option to add files that need to be considered for the cache key in pyproject.toml
items.reason: The original request for configurable project cache inputs established per-project `cache-keys`, but not inheritance between workspace members.

items.title: Add support for dynamic cache keys
items.reason: Implemented the extensible cache-key abstraction and file/Git inputs, but no dependency traversal or inherited project information.

items.title: Rebuild C Extensions only on change
items.reason: The closest workspace/native-extension workflow. Per-project cache keys solved rebuilding changed extensions, but not downstream invalidation when another member changes.

items.title: `uv sync` and `uv run` not detecting file changes when using `scikit_build_core.build` backend
items.reason: Uses the same backend and source-change symptom, but concerns inputs within one project rather than inheritance across dependencies.

items.title: Better defaults for native build backend cache keys
items.reason: Added native-source cache-key patterns to generated scikit-build-core and maturin projects without propagating invalidation to dependents.

items.title: How to make git tagging a monorepo only build the affected workspace members in CI?
items.reason: Conceptually related because dependency changes should affect downstream workspace members, but it concerns CI release selection rather than `uv sync` cache inheritance.

related.search_scope: Searched open and closed issues and open, closed, and merged pull requests using literal queries for `cache-keys`, inheritance, relative globs, and scikit-build-core; conceptual queries for workspace-dependent rebuilds, local-dependency invalidation, affected dependents, and transitive invalidation; and fix-oriented queries for cache-key implementations and native-backend defaults. Full candidate discussions, maintainer comments, closing references, and linked pull requests were inspected. astral-sh/uv#6356 was ruled out as a broad CI/Docker change-only-testing discussion, astral-sh/uv#9191 concerns Docker metadata freshness, and astral-sh/uv#15224 concerns forced non-editable reinstalls. No existing item requests cross-package cache-key inheritance.

type_reason: The reporter describes the current lack of a dependent rebuild as expected and requests a new `{ inherit = "foo" }` cache-key form. Current cache keys support file, directory, Git, and environment inputs evaluated independently for each project, with no dependency-inheritance variant. No canonical duplicate was found.
summary: Existing work provides per-project cache keys and native-backend defaults, while adjacent discussions cover same-project rebuilds or CI impact analysis. None allows a dependent to inherit another workspace member's evaluated cache information.
draft_response:
Thanks. `tool.uv.cache-keys` is currently evaluated independently for each local project, and there is no key type that inherits another workspace member's evaluated cache information. The guidance in astral-sh/uv#12399 and astral-sh/uv#15809 handles changes to a project's own native-build inputs, while astral-sh/uv#16013 covers the separate problem of identifying affected packages in CI.

This is a new enhancement. For now, `bar` must list the relevant `foo` paths in its own cache keys, relative to `bar`, or be added to `reinstall-package` if always rebuilding it is acceptable. A dependency-aware form would need design around direct versus transitive inheritance and workspace-only resolution, so we cannot promise an implementation timeline.
